import sys

mod = 10**9 + 7

def mu(x, y):
    return pow(x, y, mod)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k == 0:
        print(mu(p, p - 1))
        return
    if k == 1:
        print(mu(p, p))
        return
    m = 1
    t = k
    while True:
        m += 1
        t = (t * k) % p
        if t == 1:
            print(mu(p, (p - 1) // m))
            return

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
